title: Mode collapse from generator-discriminator imbalance
description: The generator must not be trained too much without updating the discriminator, otherwise it collapses many noise values to the same output, losing diversity in the modeled distribution.
canonical_description: generator and discriminator must be carefully synchronized during training to prevent generator mode collapse

evidence.quote: $D$ must be synchronized well with $G$ during training (in particular, $G$ must not be trained too much without updating $D$, in order to avoid ``the Helvetica scenario'' in which $G$ collapses too many values of $\mathbf{z}$ to the same value of $\mathbf{x}$ to have enough diversity to model $p_\text{data}$)
